extensionDescription.message: Sends a phone notification when Claude usage is available again

popupIntro.message: Configure the organization identifier and ntfy topic to receive an alert as soon as Claude usage is available again.

orgIdHint.message: Fill in this field with the ID captured from Claude's usage URL.

topicHint.message: Use a dedicated topic to avoid collisions with other notifications.

languageHint.message: You can follow the browser language or force a specific language for the interface and notifications.

popupInitialStatus.message: Enter an ntfy topic and save to enable automatic alerts.

helpSummary.message: Help: how to configure the extension

helpStep2.message: Inspect the browser and open the network tab to monitor the generated requests.

helpStep3Prefix.message: Click the refresh button on the usage page and find the request to

helpStep4.message: Copy the ID used in the URL and paste it into the Claude Org ID field.

helpStep5.message: Install the ntfy app and create your key or topic.

helpStep6.message: Add that information to the ntfy topic field to receive notifications.

helpNote.message: If the ID does not appear immediately, click refresh again with the network panel open until the request is captured.

footerNote.message: Unlock alerts depend on an authenticated claude.ai session in the browser.

statusTopicRequiredSave.message: Enter a valid topic before saving.

statusSaveSuccess.message: Configuration saved. Monitoring will continue in the background.

statusSaveSuccessWithoutTopic.message: Configuration saved. Add an ntfy topic to enable remote alerts.

statusTopicRequiredTest.message: Enter a topic before sending the test notification.

statusOrgIdRequired.message: Enter the Claude Org ID before checking the status.

statusTestFailure.message: Failed to send notification. Check the topic and your connection.

statusCheckFailure.message: Failed to check Claude status. Try again.

statusAuth.message: Claude session not found. Open claude.ai and sign in with this browser.

statusUnavailable.message: Unable to check the status right now. Try again shortly.
